summary: Callable piecewise-cubic Hermite interpolation with a prescribed left first derivative and a cylindrical right boundary equation.

identity.direction: Declared inputs to Callable spline retaining x_data,y_data,k and deriv=0/1/2 evaluation
identity.definition: Piecewise cubic Hermite interpolation with a boundary-specific linear slope system
identity.model: C2 cubic spline; Clamped/FirstClamped use corrected unequal-knot continuity rows
identity.geometry: one-dimensional scalar abscissa and ordinate samples
identity.coordinates: Knots in arbitrary coherent coordinate units
identity.boundary: Left first derivative yp and right fdd+fd/x-m²f/x²=0
assumptions: Finite strictly increasing matched one-dimensional knots and values with N>=3
In-domain deriv=0/1/2 for the qualified numerical claim

inputs.name: m
inputs.description: Coefficient in the cylindrical Robin row
inputs.constraints: Finite; no physical mode interpretation asserted

outputs.name: spline
outputs.description: Callable spline retaining x_data,y_data,k and deriv=0/1/2 evaluation
outputs.units: ordinate units; derivative units per coordinate power
outputs.constraints: Query array shape preserved; zero outside knot interval

preconditions: Finite strictly increasing matched one-dimensional knots and values with N>=3
In-domain deriv=0/1/2 for the qualified numerical claim
supported: Finite polynomial and spline basis selections implemented by scirel.geometry.basis
excluded: Zero extrapolation and deriv selectors other than 1/2 returning values remain compatibility conventions
Duplicate, unsorted or nonfinite knots are outside numerical qualification
Physical cylindrical magnetic-fitting boundary interpretation remains unresolved

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError or AssertionError for unsupported basis selectors, nonfinite or mismatched samples, unsorted knots, or invalid boundary parameters; linear-system failures propagate.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Numerical linear-algebra or optional SciPy special-function exceptions propagate from evaluation.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; basis construction and evaluation are direct computations without an iterative convergence claim.
failure_semantics.partial_results: A failed constructor returns no evaluator; spline queries outside the knot interval follow the implementation's zero-fill behavior.

example.description: Construct the left-clamped cylindrical spline with its default boundary parameters.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.geometry.basis import FirstClampedCubicSpline

spline = FirstClampedCubicSpline(np.array([0.0, 0.3, 1.0]), np.array([0.0, 0.2, 1.0]))
np.testing.assert_allclose(spline(np.array([0.3])), [0.2])
example.expected: The callable returns 0.2 at the interior knot and preserves the one-element query shape.
